coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Bay South Block 16A (UCSF planned)
record.summary: Block 16A is at UCSF's Mission Bay North Campus. UCSF's June 2025 presentation listed Blocks 16A and B as undeveloped research parcels with no building plans at Mission Bay; on May 6, 2026 the University of California approved a 153,600-gross-square-foot, five-level 'Mission Bay Block 16A Building' for ear and hearing care and research on Block 16A and part of 16B, which UCSF's release (the Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute, Fifth Street at Nelson Rising Lane) says will start construction in late 2026, complete in 2029 and open in 2030.

notes.accuracy_caveat: PARTIALLY REAL -- the outer boundary is a real polygonized city block from real street geometry, not hand-traced; only the internal A/B split line is approximate (a bisection, since no real street divides this block into A and B).
notes.digitized_from: Real block boundary, formed from DataSF's official street centerlines; the plan's own A/B internal split has no mapped street, so it's a straight bisection along the block's long axis, not a real line.

open_questions: UCSF's own news page for the Regents approval (ucsf.edu) could not be opened here (blocked); the release is cited through Mirage News' republication, which labels itself a public release from the originating organization.

No document read says in so many words that the 'Mission Bay Block 16A Building' in the Notice of Determination is the Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute; the match rests on the same approval date (May 6, 2026), ear-and-hearing use, five levels and donor funding.

Addendum #6 to the 2014 Long Range Development Plan EIR (April 2026, per the Notice of Determination) and the Regents item are on UCSF Real Estate's reports page, which could not be opened here; no cost was read.
Construction start is a forecast ('late 2026'); no groundbreaking or building permit was found as of 2026-10-10. The 2029 completion and 2030 occupancy are UCSF's own forecasts.
The map's 16A/16B split is a bisection, while the project takes all of 16A plus 'a portion of Block 16B' (Notice of Determination); the footprint's exact extent on 16B is not stated.
Whether any other use is planned for the rest of Block 16A: none stated. The OCII land use map shows 16A as a UCSF parcel (colour fill is graphic, not read as text).

record.notes: No building on this site as of UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck ('Undeveloped parcels remaining'; 'Block 16A & B - Research'); in USDA NAIP imagery (viewed 2026-09-29) the block reads as open graded ground with no visible parked cars, an imagery observation no cited document states. The OCII plan's Dec 2019 Land Use Map designates this block for UCSF (no use type given). This record's milestones list a May 2026 UC Regents approval of the UCSF Bakar Ear & Hearing Institute at Fifth Street and Nelson Rising Lane, citing a UCSF News page that could not be checked on 2026-09-29; whether that project is on this block is not confirmed by any source that could be checked.
